US Consumer Confidence

US Consumer Confidence Inched Up Again in March

Latest Press Release

Updated: Tuesday, March 31, 2026

The Conference Board Consumer Confidence Index® edged up by 0.8 points in March to 91.8 (1985=100), from 91.0 in February. The Present Situation Index increased by 4.6 points to 123.3.

Source: March 2026 Consumer Confidence Survey

The next release is Tuesday, April 28 at 10 AM ET.
